in_sanskrit.name: सुधर्शन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: सु (su) meaning good, धर्श (dharsh) meaning to see or behold, शन् (shan) meaning fortuned or prosperous. So, Sudharshan means 'good fortune that is beheld or seen'.

in_hindi.name: सुधर्शन
in_hindi.long_meaning: शुभ (shubh) meaning good, प्रभाव (prabhav) meaning effect, शुभ (shubh) meaning good, दृश्य (drishy) meaning sight. So, Sudharshan means 'good effect that is seen'.

in_tamil.name: ஸுதர்ச்சன
in_tamil.long_meaning: விருப்பம் (viruppam) meaning prosperous, பிரவிம்மல் (pravimmal) meaning auspicious. So, Sudharshan means 'prosperous and auspicious'.

in_telugu.name: సుధర్శన
in_telugu.long_meaning: శుభ (shubha) meaning good, దేశ (desha) meaning lord, శుభ (shubha) meaning good, పోజేశ (pojesh) meaning prosperous. So, Sudharshan means 'good lord that is prosperous'.

in_marathi.name: Sudharshan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sudharshan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sudharshan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sudharshana', which means 'auspicious' or 'prosperous'.
